title: Shows lint easily; very thin throw good for a light covering but is not super warm; holds static
text:
Shows lint easily; very thin throw good for a light covering but is not super warm; holds static. This very thin blanket comes packaged in a zippered plastic bag (mine was a ripped zippered plastic bag) with a piece of gold ribbon. I suspect the ribbon is to use for gift giving. To me that piece is unnecessary (see last photo).

This throw is generously sized and covers two thirds of the top of my king-sized bed as can be seen in the photos. Immediately, lint, fuzz, and cat hair started to show on the deep blue blanket. It is worse when the air in my house is dry as the blanket becomes full of static and hairs tend to stick to it. However, that is to be expected. This throw is very thin and is good to use when a light covering is needed but it is not super warm. I tend to LOVE SUPER PLUSH blankets and throws and this one is not that. Nevertheless, my three cats love this and Stephen immediately claimed his space.

I think the current price of $17.99 is competitive and acceptable for what one gets. However, although I love the softness and intense blue color, I would have preferred something thicker. My absolute favorite thick throw is the [[ASIN:B07J6GBTBW Life Comfort Throw in the Brown Quartz color]].

Note that the tag says this is machine washable on gentle cycle and to tumble dry this on low.
